connections.description: Two locating tongues per panel inserted downward into matching bottom sockets; original kit M3x12 fasteners retain against pullout. Front blue/green is one solid, no inter-book fasteners.
Seats are integral material in blue_spine and lid, not glue-on blocks. Four7x3 magnets with0.6mm retaining membranes and2.2mm magnetic face gap; check polarity and holding force physically.

Upper side atY0 Z174, M4x20 through2mm inner metal pad+4mm fixed arm web+4mm side panel+3.6mm sleeve+1.4mm washer+4mm nut. Metal threads only. Remove hardware for panel extraction, not for ordinary lid opening.

4x100x182.4 rectangles remain unchanged, downward guided. Numerical panel extraction is clear at an artificially posed100deg lid, but that pose is not reachable through the current opening sweep. Before correction, remove lid/axle for maintenance.

30x1 nominal inset surface strips: lower U fixed to front/base/back, upper inverted U fixed to lid. Separate at opening Z128..128.6 and rear hinge Z123.5..134; compatible adhesive only as non-loadbearing decoration. No peelable patch or release action. Hollow buckle conforms to blue arc.
Only non-load-bearing spine marks use compatible thin adhesive. No shoulder strap included.
